summary: Master Advanced GIS techniques for decision support and administrative planning. Join our training course to elevate your expertise and drive better outcomes!
lede: In administrative planning, advanced GIS turns spatial data into evidence for site selection, service coverage and resource allocation. Designed for GIS professionals, planners and administrative officers, the course covers geospatial data quality checks, suitability and network modelling, and repeatable workflow automation with ModelBuilder or Python. Learners also practice presenting recommendations through maps and decision briefs.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already use GIS and now need to apply advanced GIS for decision support and administrative planning in live operational settings. GIS Analysts preparing spatial decision models and map outputs. Urban and Regional Planners evaluating land use and service access. Administrative Planning Officers turning spatial evidence into resource decisions. Transport Planners using network analysis for routing and coverage. Spatial Data Specialists cleaning geodatabases and validating layers. Cartographers producing decision maps for management review. Geospatial Project Coordinators tracking deliverables and workflow dependencies. Environmental Planning Officers assessing terrain and watershed constraints. Infrastructure Planning Analysts ranking candidate sites and service locations. GIS Supervisors standardizing analytical workflows across planning teams.
modules: GIS automation with ModelBuilder and Python
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, access to ArcGIS Pro or QGIS, and a willingness to work through planning datasets and guided lab exercises. Prior exposure to map reading, spatial layers, and basic geoprocessing is important; no advanced coding background is required.
